messages:
rachel: Heads-up — trying to cut the sample-app SDK but `yarn typegen` created a regen diff that changes auth/retry placement across languages. TS exposes retry as a positional arg, Go/py still use opts. Smoke tests fail.
tom: Oof. paste the minimal TS diff?
rachel:
```diff
- Authenticate(creds Credentials, opts *AuthOpts)
+ Authenticate(creds Credentials, retry bool, opts *AuthOpts)
```
ivy: That’s a parity + semver problem. If TS suddenly exposes positional retry that’s a breaking change for some callers. Did OpenAPI change?
rachel: No OpenAPI edits. Using `@redwood/typegen` v0.12.3. Generator re-grouped optional params in TS only.
changelog-bot: changelog-bot: applied label "auto:patch" to PR #331 (rule: docs-only)
oliver: The changelog automation misclassified this. We need cross-SDK signature diffs to be treated as "semver:review".
regen-bot: regen-bot: opened PR #331 "typegen: stabilize param grouping across SDKs" (CI: pending)
tom: Short term: hold release and unpublish TS artifacts if already pushed. Also add a CI guard that diffs generated signatures across languages and fails if they diverge without schema change.
ivy: Agreed. I'll add a regen-diff parity check for TS/Python/Go and a small unit test asserting stable ordering in typegen.
oliver: Filing follow-ups: 1) unpublish/revert JS SDK, 2) parity regen-diff gate, 3) changelog rule update to flag cross-language signature changes, 4) short postmortem if revert happens.
rachel: Revert PR: https://git.redwood.ai/p/sample-apps/pulls/331-revert — tagging @ivy for release ops. Will confirm when smoke suite is green. :thumbsup:
